proof_body:
by
  intro f g a L hf hg hg0 hq
  have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f x / g x * g x) (nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ) (nhds (L * 0)) := hq.mul hg0
  have h2 : Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ) (nhds 0) := by
    rw [mul_zero] at h1
    refine h1.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hx
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hg x hx)
  have h3 : Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ) (nhds (f a)) := hf.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique h3 h2
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a L : ℝ), ContinuousAt f a → (∀ x, x ≠ a → g x ≠ 0) → Filter.Tendsto g (nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ) (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f x / g x) (nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ) (nhds L) → f a = 0
